author: Cinna Davis (with OpenAI Codex)
statement: At grade h=9 with the existing eight asymmetric input labels, replacing the output codebook by eight even-length partitions yields an invertible cubic-weighted scalar pairing and an exact eight-label crossing with shifts -1,0,1 omitted. This is a finite changed-codebook result and does not improve the SAT bound. The complete crossing identity depends on the predecessor parity and affine-energy proof; one output vector is checked directly.
remaining_obligations: Uniform high-rank input pairings and codebook selection for all grades
Independent review of shared operator construction and parity proof
An asymptotic directional-rank gain and complete SAT cost accounting
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent or formal review
